title: Enzymatic aminolysis in continuous flow: an efficient strategy for the synthesis of salicylamide derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11744-11751
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09739H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Li-Hua Du, Miao-Miao Xue, Bing-Lin Yan, Lin Wang, Xi-Ping Luo
Reaction parameters were optimized in a K2CO3/Lipozyme® TL IM catalyzed continuous-flow microreactor. An efficient biocatalytic strategy afforded 34 salicylamide derivatives. This work supports their synthesis and industrialization.
